description: Introduces localization improvements, Material 3 Expressive design enhancements, and various bug fixes.

logs.desc: Gestures support allowing the user to use physical or mouse gestures to interact with video player actions.
A dedicated keybind toggle master switch ("toggleKeybindsEp") allowing users to enable/disable keyboard shortcuts dynamically, persisting state via PlayerStorage.
Optimized the video player even further for low-end devices.
Rebuilt the "Video Player" from scratch.
Cookie Policy page.

Keyboard shortcuts (keybinds) for video player controls: Play/Pause (Space/K), Mute (M), Fullscreen (F), Loop (L), Autoplay (A), Cinema Mode (C), Subtitles (S), Volume Up/Down (ArrowUp/ArrowDown), Seek Forward/Backward (ArrowRight/ArrowLeft), and Playback Speed Up/Down (] or . / [ or ,).
Japanese and German localization support.
Material 3 Expressive placeholders on the Settings page.
A new Material 3 Expressive context menu with actions for opening pages, refreshing, and browser navigation (back/forward).
Added an SVG button to the hero template featuring a new back navigation icon.
Caching support to "LanguageHandler".
Additional descriptive tooltips across the interface.
"Previous episode", "Next episode", "Like episode", and "Dislike episode" buttons above the watch page description.
"radioButton.astro" and "radioButtonHandler.ts" to unify and modularize radio button logic.
"Auto Play", "Settings", and "Playback Speed" controls to the "Video Player".
Updated Button and NavBar components to follow the Material 3 Expressive design language.
Refactored the overall website layout for improved responsiveness and usability.
Adjusted the episode list layout: smaller screens now display a single-column view, while larger screens use three columns instead of four.
LanguageHandler now ignores elements and their descendants when `data-translate="false"` is present.
Sliders now modify values on hover when the scroll wheel is moved up or down.
Season switcher buttons now display season cover art and the season name, defaulting to the anime name if unavailable.
Applied Material 3 Expressive themes to input fields and custom toggle buttons.
Set the global theme to monochrome and introduced accessibility-focused 'LightAccent' and 'Highlight' variants.
Redesigned the loading screen to be more visually consistent with the website.
Removed translucent backgrounds from changelog type pills (e.g., Added, Changed, Fixed).
Enhanced "animeCard", "gridEpisodeButton", "seasonSwitcher", and "info" layouts with modern Material 3 Expressive styling.
Resolved layout clipping issues in the video player and episode list. The looping and cinema-light toggle buttons are now properly hidden.
LanguageHandler now correctly translates dynamically appended elements after the initial page load.
Temporarily deprecated the "Fansub" / "translations" section on the watch page until its functionality is fully implemented.
Removed the slogan section from the landing page.
Transparency and blur effects from the video player elements.
"Previous episode" and "Next episode" buttons from the video player controller.
Accent-colored hover backgrounds from "Title" and "Time Stamp" elements, replacing them with a bold font transition.
Legacy "customRadioButton.astro" component.
Banner information details from the anime info page.
